main.name: Sara
main.title: Senior Backend & Data Engineer
main.tagline: Always learning, mostly about data, AI and the systems in between.
bio: I'm a senior backend and data engineer. I spent three years building inside a bank, where data has to be right and systems can't go down. My favourite work is shaping data for machine learning.

Now I work remotely and finally have time to build my own things in the open. I love learning and working with AI, from the fundamentals to agents, and I believe it should make people's lives better. Open source and Linux are where I feel at home.
